pages.text: $(bold)Intentional Early Access$(/bold)$(br2)The pack is designed to let skilled players $(italic)bend$(/italic) the tier system — not break it. Getting one or two next-tier items early is a feature. Fully bypassing a tier is a bug.$(br2)Two legitimate methods exist for early access to next-tier materials:

$(bold)Method 1: Transmutation$(/bold)$(br2)KubeJS recipes allow expensive conversion of current-tier materials into small amounts of next-tier materials:$(br2)32–64 current-tier ingots → 1 next-tier ingot$(br2)Available through Create mixing, Thermal smelting, or Botania infusion. Intentionally inefficient — this provides a taste, not a full unlock. A Tier 2 player might build $(italic)one$(/italic) Mekanism machine from transmuted osmium.

$(bold)Method 2: Boss Drop Peeks$(/bold)$(br2)Current-tier bosses have a 5–15% chance to drop 1–3 next-tier materials:$(br2)$(li)Twilight Forest bosses → osmium, steel$(li)Tier 3 bosses → ancient debris, Gaia spirit fragments$(br2)This rewards boss hunting without breaking the gate. A Tier 2 player who kills many Twilight bosses might accumulate enough osmium to build something interesting — but not a factory.
